_comment: Bubble lines, per side and per situation (hero-banter change). Russian on purpose: the app speaks one language and has no localisation mechanism -- see docs/product-analysis.md non-goal 12, restated rather than deleted. Written and read once, shipped as data; nothing is generated at runtime, because the app has no network. Every line is short enough for a six-year-old to read in the time a bubble is on screen, carries no adult irony, no insult a child should not repeat, and never mocks the player for losing -- the bot hangs pieces on purpose (ADR-0005) and the child will be behind sometimes. `check` takes priority over the other three situations.

white._who: the fallen angel -- the player's own commander. Dry, teasing, needles the necromancer rather than cheering the child on.

black._who: the necromancer -- the opponent. A boastful villain who is not very good at it, and knows it half a second too late.
check: Я не готов! Я не готов!
